fields.v: No (0): all skill conditions evaluated (personalized, other-developer, generic, ablations) come from the authors' own skill-generation framework; the only comparator is the no-skill baseline, which is not an external approach. Authors independent of Codex CLI, GPT and Claude (executor and judge only)
fields.quote: We consider four conditions: (A) no skill, (B) the target developer’s personalized skill, (C) a personalized skill from another random developer and (D) a generic skill pooled across all developers.
fields.why: Partly applies when the authors' approach is compared with external approaches; here every evaluated skill is the authors' own and the comparator is only a no-skill baseline, so No may fit the rule better.
fields.doubt: Todas as condições com skill (B, C, D, E, F) saem do framework dos autores; a única alternativa é 'sem skill', que não é uma abordagem externa. A regra dá Parcial só quando a abordagem própria é comparada com abordagens externas. Lê §3.2 (pág. 5) e decide Q12: Não (0) ou manter Parcial.
